scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist-test/test/utils.test.js && node --test dist-test/test/eventBus.test.js dist-test/test/botInteractions.test.js dist-test/test/commandUi.test.js dist-test/test/commandAutocomplete.test.js dist-test/test/soundDownloads.test.js dist-test/test/soundDownloadConfirmation.test.js dist-test/test/presence.test.js dist-test/test/voiceConnection.test.js dist-test/test/voiceModeReconnect.test.js dist-test/test/shortcuts.test.js dist-test/test/releaseNotes.test.js dist-test/test/audioPreferences.test.js dist-test/test/serverSettings.test.js dist-test/test/favorites.test.js dist-test/test/cameraEffects.test.js dist-test/test/screenColorPicker.test.js dist-test/test/serverSettingsStore.test.js dist-test/test/hostedServerLifecycle.test.js test/serverManagerLifecycle.test.cjs
scripts.test:camera: node test/cameraEffectsSmoke.cjs && node test/cameraEffectsSmoke.cjs --packaged && node test/cameraPublicationSmoke.cjs

scripts.test:bots: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/botInteractions.test.js dist-test/test/commandUi.test.js dist-test/test/commandAutocomplete.test.js dist-test/test/soundDownloads.test.js dist-test/test/soundDownloadConfirmation.test.js
scripts.test:shortcuts: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node --test dist-test/test/shortcuts.test.js && node test/shortcutWorkerSmoke.cjs
